{{Quote|These were the coordinates they wrote down for me. On paper. I mean, who uses paper?|[[Jan (Rebel)|Jan]], a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], during an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] interrogation|<ref name="Rebel Heist 1">[[Rebel Heist 1|''Rebel Heist'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Paper''' was a material used in the production of written documents. Although it bore a resemblance to [[Durasheet/Legends|durasheet]], paper was not designed with the utility of reusability in mind. As technological progress was made, paper was superseded by data storage devices such as [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]] and was rarely used. During the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]], [[Anakin Solo]] used a pen and paper to record the coordinates of each [[Star/Legends|star]] that was targeted for destruction by the [[Sacorrian Triad]], as well as the time of each, by memory.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Paper has been in the mix for decades, but it's long been suggested to be rare and outdated by modern standards.|[[Pablo Hidalgo]] discusses paper in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe|<ref name="Paper tweet 3">{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|/status/1121864109459292160|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Paper has been in the mix for decades, but it's long been suggested to be rare and outdated by modern standards.|archivedate=20190722131736}}</ref>}}
The [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook for the first edition]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' stressed that "there is no paper in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe" and that the inhabitants of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] exclusively used electronic means of data storage. In addition to the use of paper in publications, such as ''[[Assault at Selonia]]'', this attitude towards the use of paper in the ''Star Wars'' universe seemed to relax by the time that the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|rulebook for the game's second edition]] was published. It stated that paper was "rarely, if ever used" by the galaxy's inhabitants.
